method: Reviewer checked raw original BRIEF/API clause-by-clause, then inspected each cited runtime/source route and independent expected values; this is not merely a mechanical index-completeness assertion. Crosswalk IDs are retained as stable names.

entries.original_clause: Real reusable SwiftUI and Compose production components in the exact exported paths.
entries.independent_review: Both exact production files are mandatory source-scoped items. Bridges instantiate the API directly; no substitute UI is present in the approved bridge.

entries.original_clause: availableMB >= downloadSizeMB, supplied whole decimal MB, with no disk measurement.
entries.independent_review: Independent interpreter confirms sampled gates. Equality and unmetered paths are deliberately source-reviewed through the complete >= predicate, rather than claimed as native executions.

entries.original_clause: Insufficient storage wins over network gate.
entries.independent_review: The appended competing-gates fixture presents storage and network holds together; Storage needed and disabled primary are independently expected. Source decision-order review covers the general rule.

entries.original_clause: Wi-Fi-only starts selected and remains independently observable.
entries.independent_review: All initial models expect selected=true and enabled=true independently, with a literal label. Source native-selected construction supplements the runtime trait check.

entries.original_clause: Metered Wi-Fi-only selection blocks; deselection permits when storage sufficient.
entries.independent_review: Initial true/false/true/false choice route exercises metered gate reversal. The complete source predicate retains sufficient storage and pending-request guards.

entries.original_clause: Each native choice activation toggles and calls onWifiOnlyChange(result) once.
entries.independent_review: Independent event interpreter matches each actual activation index, resulting Boolean and exactly one event. Held-choice remains enabled even under storage hold.

entries.original_clause: Eligible primary invokes onDownload(current tour.id,current wifiOnly) exactly once.
entries.independent_review: Request receipt binds successful action6, current model ID and current preference. Source review separately covers the unmetered Wi-Fi-true path absent from sampled native inputs.

entries.original_clause: Request changes local requested state and disables choice and primary, with requested labels/status.
entries.independent_review: Requested full and requested-closed full states retain disabled choice/primary, requested status and Requested label, while disclosure remains enabled.

entries.original_clause: Records request only; does not fetch audio.
entries.independent_review: Both source files have explicit no-audio-fetch obligations. This is source review, not a claim about rendered pixels.

entries.original_clause: Initially closed; disclosure toggles all chapter pairs in caller order.
entries.independent_review: Initial closed, real open and real post-request close are separately observed. Permitted/requested full sweeps carry exact eight heading/body pairs and caller order.

entries.original_clause: Disclosure open and close have no caller business callback.
entries.independent_review: Opening action1 and closing action8 have their own empty expected intervals and require successful native activation; source no-callback paths are separate.

entries.original_clause: Disclosure remains enabled after request.
entries.independent_review: Native enabled checks apply after request; the close callback assertion requires real successful dispatch at action8.

entries.original_clause: New ID resets local Wi-Fi-only to true.
entries.independent_review: Replacement selected=true follows a prior false choice; a later actual held-choice activation confirms the reset choice is enabled.

entries.original_clause: New ID resets local disclosure to closed.
entries.independent_review: The runtime replacement is closed. Because disclosure was already closed immediately before the update, the source reset-disclosure item is necessary to prove the reset branch rather than infer it from this sample.

entries.original_clause: New ID resets requested false and current rendered model values together.
entries.independent_review: Replacement title/subtitle/status/primary labels update after a requested state, with source reset-requested and current-model rendering checks. P1 remains storage-blocked and P2 network-blocked.

entries.original_clause: Same mounted component receives actual caller fixture update with no callbacks.
entries.independent_review: The event rule explicitly sets caller_update and stimulus_action10/13. Frozen callback_verdict requires caller_fixture_update, successful dispatch, same instance/process, advanced input and the original event interval.

entries.original_clause: Exact title/subtitle, status precedence, Review/Hide, Get audio/Requested, Wi-Fi only labels.
entries.independent_review: Fresh independent interpreter reproduces exact current title, language/MB composition, precedence, disclosure, choice and primary labels in all30 input/state combinations.

entries.original_clause: P1 400x600; P2 280x600 xxxLarge/1.3; light LTR; host horizontal16 top24; same API/source.
entries.independent_review: Separate frozen acceptance.environment checks actual native width/height/theme/direction/text scale; original environment files and their approval digests match. Host templates supply16 horizontal and24 top padding.

entries.original_clause: Retain original overview/permitted/requested/replaced full-state checkpoints.
entries.independent_review: Overview/permitted/requested/replaced each keep explicit fresh full-content sweeps. The amended requested-closed is also full; intermediate states are only targeted as approved.

entries.original_clause: Full-width pale canvas, white surface, accent/title/subtitle/status/disclosure/chapters/choice/primary in vertical flow.
entries.independent_review: Separate canvas/surface/ink pixel atoms and full-flow/single-column/full-width visual propositions cover ownership and order. The native parent owns scrolling and width.

entries.original_clause: 8 gutter,16 padding,6x40 accent,12/16 internal gaps, nominal status56 are advisory layout tokens.
entries.independent_review: Original text explicitly makes generic internal layout tokens and status minimum height advisory. This cannot certify actual SwiftUI padding or convert it to a MUST pass.

entries.original_clause: Actual native choice-to-primary edge gap is12 +/-0.75 pt/dp in same coherent frame.
entries.independent_review: The actual control basis uses gap_y with exact native units and independently sourced0.75 tolerance. Both unique fully visible controls must share one coherent frame.

entries.original_clause: Actual displayed status text starts at least16 native units inside painted band.
entries.independent_review: A real distinct statusText node is measured against the real painted band on semantic basis: inset_left publicly, inset_right privately, gte16 without a tolerance. No computed padding is fabricated.

entries.original_clause: Whole leading4% status strip stays fill-only.
entries.independent_review: Full logical leading4% strip has minimum support1.0 and exact opaque status-role color. RTL uses physical right[0.96,0,1,1], LTR physical left[0,0,0.04,1].

entries.original_clause: All displayed text wraps without truncation/ellipsis.
entries.independent_review: Eight distinct source questions cover title/subtitle/status/disclosure/choice/primary/headings/bodies. They accept original native frames only; source uncapped-line configuration is a separate added obligation.

entries.original_clause: Parent provides scrolling; no nested scroller or manufactured fixed-height blank rows.
entries.independent_review: Both source files explicitly forbid nested scrolling and blank fixed-height rows manufacturing scrolling. Generic parent source shows its actual scrolling container.

entries.original_clause: Overlapping complete content and bottom reachability for representative expanded states.
entries.independent_review: Permitted/requested representative expanded states require full coverage, overlap and bottom reachability. Targeted intermediate states do not substitute for them under the prospective amendment.

entries.original_clause: Fixed distinct waiting/ready/requested/blocked rendered status fills.
entries.independent_review: The original distinct waiting palette is restored for Wi-Fi required. Source-role mapping now matches business meaning; all10 states retain status pixel assertions.

entries.original_clause: Exact opaque canvas/surface/solid ink and enabled/disabled primary region colors.
entries.independent_review: Separate opaque ARGB atoms use original role colors, exact zero channel tolerance and declared solid regions. The solid ink mark is not asserted to prove glyph ink.

entries.original_clause: Exact computed SwiftUI font/text ink unavailable and advisory.
entries.independent_review: Exact computed SwiftUI font/text ink remains advisory. Required hierarchy/wrapping/overlap/clipping keep visual questions and no computed-font MUST is fabricated.

entries.original_clause: Title hierarchy, wrapping, overlap and clipping remain separate required visual propositions.
entries.independent_review: Independent qualitative questions, ownership, typed true expectations and provenance are generated by the real catalog API. Two-panel consensus retains disagreement as unknown.

entries.original_clause: Selected/enabled semantic checks and successful native dispatch must precede callback verdict.
entries.independent_review: callback_verdict rejects disabled-empty-interval controls as unassessed. Selected/enabled observations and actual callback dispatch are separate assertions.

entries.original_clause: Exact public Swift model declarations, Equatable/Identifiable conformances, stored public values, initializers and View signature.
entries.independent_review: All three exact declaration contracts preserve public lets, initializers, conformances and View/body. The future14 module/client check additionally exercises the real exported module.

entries.original_clause: Production component remains iOS14 compatible.
additional_routes: check_minimum_api.py run() read only; never imported/executed during review
compatibility.json shared real-library module emission and unchanged bridge typecheck at14, plus manual availability audit; no packaging/link/runtime claim
entries.independent_review: The original minimum14 SOURCE/API constraint has manual availability audit plus pinned real-library module emission and unchanged bridge typecheck at14. Current observer17 is not reused as proof. Legacy packaging/link/runtime remain unverified.

entries.original_clause: Exact Kotlin data classes, package, Composable signature and modifier:Modifier=Modifier.
entries.independent_review: All three declaration contracts preserve data classes, vals, types, package and Composable callback signature including modifier:Modifier=Modifier. No Swift module result is used for Android.

entries.original_clause: Bridges decode current model and forward real callbacks, own no UI/state/layout/results or replacement.
entries.independent_review: Inspected bridge code only decodes current fields, constructs models, invokes the production component and forwards actual callbacks. No state, layout, identity wrapper or expectation logic is present.

entries.original_clause: Every literal semantic identifier belongs to exactly one real node, with no proxy duplicates.
entries.independent_review: Runtime exact selectors require unique native nodes; source propositions require real-node IDs, actual band/text allocations and no proxy duplication. The added statusText ID is distinct.

entries.original_clause: Canvas/surface are noninteractive containers; ink rectangle is accessible and noninteractive.
entries.independent_review: Explicit source propositions cover canvas/surface/ink noninteractive roles and container descendant preservation. Native label/pixel evidence remains separate.

entries.original_clause: Status identifier belongs to whole painted band; no duplicate status ID on text.
entries.independent_review: Both source provenance propositions and separate native band/text labels/inset remain mandatory. Parent status ID may not be repeated on Text.

entries.original_clause: Disclosure, choice, primary are actual Buttons; selected and disabled native semantics; descendant controls preserved.
entries.independent_review: Both platforms retain real Button source obligations and native control selected/disabled checks. Canvas/surface source obligations preserve independently addressable descendants.

entries.original_clause: AX labels exclude decorative marks and status concatenation.
entries.independent_review: Exact native choice/disclosure/primary labels reject concatenated status or decorative marks. This is directly observable on the real controls.

entries.original_clause: Primary label fills rectangular56 native control allocation with matching content shape.
entries.independent_review: Native control-basis height56 +/-0.75, visible rectangular paint/full allocation and fill are separate from source full-label/content-shape configuration. None claims physical hit-area verification.

entries.original_clause: All disclosure/choice/requested state and identity reset logic remain production-owned.
entries.independent_review: Both component state and reset paths are explicitly production-scoped; approved bridges have no state or .id/key wrapper.

entries.original_clause: All text is configured without a finite line limit.
entries.independent_review: Source configuration forbids finite line caps separately from all eight rendered wrapping questions. Source review cannot make rendered wrapping pass.

entries.original_clause: Retain the original/revised visible status-rectangle requirement.
entries.independent_review: Separate source-backed original-native-frame visual proposition retained. Rectangle/no-border/paint allocation are not inferred from pixel fill or source shape configuration.
